title: karabiner liberator: link ~/.config/karabiner, as a directory, from the user repo's config/karabiner
body:
## What

A `karabiner` liberator: Karabiner-Elements' config lives in the user repo, as the hammerspoon liberator keeps `~/.hammerspoon/init.lua` there. hv asked for it through rhadamanth-sysadm on 3 Nov 2026 (its brief: `/Users/matts/Devel/agt/rhadamanth-sysadm/work/2026-11-03-karabiner-liberator-brief.md`). molt-dc's ask to vc (2026-11-03 05:38Z, 51e8bd5) corrected the brief on three points, and all three are taken here.

hv, 3 Nov, in molt-vc's TUI: decision 43 is lifted, and this ships in 1.4.0 with 0072 ask 2 and 0078. "Just do this all on HEAD. The only other activity now is the Pplr rebuild and these Molt changes are trivial, so just do them and get this done." On the desk: "Do it on head and just do it. I will tell pplr-vc that is happening."

## Next

1. `liberators/karabiner.sh`, cldr's shape with hammerspoon's macOS guard:
   - `_karabiner_links`: `<user repo>/config/karabiner` to `<XDG config home>/karabiner`, as a directory, only when the repo has that directory. Karabiner saves `karabiner.json` by writing a new file and renaming it over the old one, and its docs say to link `~/.config/karabiner`, never the file (karabiner-elements.pqrs.org/docs/manual/misc/configuration-file-path/).
   - check, install and verify go through `molt_report_link_faults` and `molt_link_all`, each guarded on `molt_platform` (macOS only). It links config only: Karabiner-Elements itself is installed by hand, since its driver needs the user's approval.
   - A real `~/.config/karabiner` is adopted. When its `karabiner.json` is missing or byte-identical to the repo's, install moves each of its other entries (`assets/`, `automatic_backups/`) into the repo directory where the repo has no entry of that name, then links through `molt_link`, which keeps whatever is left as the dated `.molt-backup`. When its `karabiner.json` differs, install refuses before moving anything and names both files, so the user chooses which is kept.
   - Karabiner's docs say its agent must be restarted once after the directory becomes a link, or changes to the file go undetected. When install made the link in this run and `gui/<uid>/org.pqrs.service.agent.Karabiner-Console-User-Server` is loaded, install runs `launchctl kickstart -k` on it. A failed kickstart fails install and names the command to run by hand.
2. Karabiner honours `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` (same docs page). The rule lives only in cldr's private `_cldr_config_dir` (`liberators/cldr.sh`): `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` when it is set and absolute, else `~/.config`. Lift it into one lib helper that cldr and karabiner both call; `cldr.bats` passes unchanged. Karabiner reads the variable from its launchd agent's environment, so a sleeve that sets it publishes it through env. Nothing sets it on rhadamanth, in the shell or in launchd.
3. `test/liberators/karabiner.bats`, from `cldr.bats`, with launchctl faked as `test_helper.bash` does:
   - before install, check reports the link missing;
   - install links the directory, then check and verify pass;
   - a save that renames a new file over `karabiner.json` lands in the repo;
   - an identical real directory is adopted: `assets/` and `automatic_backups/` end up in the repo and the link is made;
   - a differing one is refused with nothing moved;
   - a repo without `config/karabiner` links nothing;
   - off macOS nothing happens;
   - the kickstart runs once on a new link, not on a re-run, and not when the agent is not loaded;
   - an absolute `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is honoured.
4. The rows cldr added: README's liberator table, CHANGELOG Unreleased, `intent/llm/MODULES.md`, the bootstrap runbook's list.
5. Molt-matts: `config/karabiner/automatic_backups/` goes in the root `.gitignore`; the backups are kept, moved in. `assets/` is tracked. Enable `karabiner` (os macos) in `instances/rhadamanth/molt.toml` only once 1.4.0 is installed there: 1.3.0 does not know it, so resleeve would skip it as unknown and doctor's enabled-liberators check would fail. gyges waits for hv's word, after its live file is compared with the repo's.
6. Rollout, hv's: quit Karabiner's Settings window, then `molt upgrade`. The proof:
   - `readlink ~/.config/karabiner` names the repo directory, and verify passes;
   - `~/.local/share/karabiner/log/console_user_server.log` shows a `Load .../karabiner.json` line after the kickstart;
   - Caps Lock acts as Control on the built-in keyboard and on the Keychron B11 Pro (BT);
   - one toggle in Karabiner's Settings shows as a Molt-matts diff, with the link still in place.

## State when filed

- Molt-matts 70f727e holds `config/karabiner/karabiner.json`, byte-identical to rhadamanth's live file.
- rhadamanth's live `~/.config/karabiner` is a real directory (0700): `karabiner.json` (0600), `assets/complex_modifications/` (empty) and `automatic_backups/` (13 files).
- The Keychron B11 Pro (BT) device entry (vendor 13364, product 1968, `is_keyboard` and `is_pointing_device`, `"ignore": false`) is load-bearing: without it Karabiner skips that keyboard, and the Caps Lock and Control swap stops working on it. Device entries apply only to connected devices, so rhadamanth and gyges can share one file.
- Karabiner-Elements is in /Applications, not from a brew cask. Its Console-User-Server agent is loaded and running on rhadamanth.


## As built (dc, 3 Nov 2026; reviewed and accepted by vc at b0b8efd and 8cdeaf6)

- `liberators/karabiner.sh` links `config/karabiner` to the `karabiner` directory under the XDG config home, as a directory, on macOS only, and only when the repo has it.
  - A real directory there is adopted. Each of its entries moves into the repo directory where the repo has no entry of that name, including a `karabiner.json` the repo lacks, and `molt_link` keeps the rest as the dated `.molt-backup`.
  - When both hold a `karabiner.json` and the two differ, install refuses before moving anything and names both files.
  - Once install has made the link in that run, it kickstarts `gui/<uid>/org.pqrs.service.agent.Karabiner-Console-User-Server` when launchd has it loaded. A failed kickstart fails install and names the command.
- `lib/molt.sh`: `molt_xdg_config_home` is the XDG config home rule, lifted from cldr's private `_cldr_config_dir`. cldr and karabiner both call it.
- Tests: `test/liberators/karabiner.bats` pins every case in Next 3. It also covers adoption with no live `karabiner.json`, a live one adopted into a repo directory without one, an entry the repo already has kept in the backup, and a failed kickstart. `cldr.bats` passes unchanged.
- vc's runs: both test files and the framework's liberator tests pass under Homebrew bash 5.3.20 and /bin/bash 3.2.57. shellcheck -x and intent critic shell are clean.
- Docs: README's liberator table, CHANGELOG Unreleased (Added), `intent/llm/MODULES.md` and the bootstrap runbook's list.
- Molt-matts a6154dd ignores `config/karabiner/automatic_backups/`. `karabiner.json` and `assets/` stay tracked.

Owed, once 1.4.0 is cut and installed on rhadamanth:
- Molt-matts enables `karabiner` (os macos) in `instances/rhadamanth/molt.toml`.
- hv quits Karabiner's Settings window and runs `molt upgrade`.
- Next 6's proof.
- gyges waits for hv's word, after its live file is compared with the repo's.


## Rolled out on rhadamanth (3 Nov 2026)

Homebrew's Molt 1.4.0 (d0a4518) runs on rhadamanth. Molt-matts dfb0e56 enables karabiner there, and hv's `molt upgrade` ran the liberator at 07:24Z.
- `~/.config/karabiner` links to `~/Devel/cfg/Molt-matts/config/karabiner`.
- `assets/` and `automatic_backups/` moved into the repo directory, and the rest of the old one is kept as `~/.config/karabiner.molt-backup.20261103112447`. Molt-matts stays clean, with the backups ignored.
- Karabiner's `console_user_server.log` shows a `Load .../karabiner.json` at 07:24:47Z, the second the link was made, which is the agent's restart.
- `molt doctor` passes every check, enabled liberators included.

Owed:
- hv's check that Caps Lock acts as Control on the built-in keyboard and on the Keychron B11 Pro (BT).
- gyges, on hv's word. molt-dc found gyges's `~/.config/karabiner` is a 2024 link to `~/.config/mfs/other/karabiner`, whose `karabiner.json` differs from the repo's (an Apple keyboard, 1452/635, with caps_lock and left_control swapped). Karabiner-Elements is not installed there.


## hv's rulings on what is left (3 Nov 2026, relayed by molt-dc)

- gyges: "We don't Karabiner or these others on gyges." gyges gets no karabiner, and none of arngz, hammerspoon, herdr or menuz; it runs Homebrew's Molt 1.4.0 with doctor green, and nothing more is enabled there.
- rhadamanth's hand checks are hv's own: Caps Lock as Control on the built-in keyboard and on the Keychron B11 Pro (BT), and one Karabiner Settings change showing as a Molt-matts diff with the link in place. vc records them here when hv reports them.
